question: As per the State of the World's Children 2024, by 2050s more than a third of the world's children will live in four countries. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sudan**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
__ 

• According to the **State of the World's Children 2024**, by the **2050s**, over a third of the world's children will reside in just four countries: **India**, **Nigeria**, **Pakistan**, and **China**. 

• This demographic trend is driven by factors such as **population growth rates**, **fertility rates**, and **youthful population structures** in these nations. 

• **India** is expected to remain the most populous country globally, with a significant proportion of its population being children, due to its high fertility rates and large population base. 

• **Nigeria**, a country with one of the highest fertility rates in the world, will experience a surge in its child population, contributing significantly to this trend. 

• **Pakistan** and **China**, owing to their large populations and substantial child demographics, will also account for a significant share of the world’s children.
